excerpt: The ATLAS detector is installed in its experimental cavern at Point 1 of the CERN Large Hadron Collider. During Run 2 of the LHC, a luminosity of L=2x10^34 cm^-2 s^-1 was routinely achieved at the start of fills, twice the design luminosity.
title: The ATLAS Experiment at the CERN Large Hadron Collider: A Description of the Detector Configuration for Run 3
